metadata.what: Water polygons that take precedence over land_local.geojson. Validator rule (unchanged): WATER if inside any feature here; else LAND if inside any land_local.geojson feature; else WATER.
metadata.zones: coastal_band = corrects the coastal-band chart polygon (creeks, lakes, ponds, tidal flats, shoreline strips); tiger_complement = defines all water inside the tiger_complement land rectangles; harbour_tile = inland water bodies only (>=85% on charted land) - charted shorelines are never moved.
metadata.geometry_note: Every polygon is a single ring without interior rings: islands are cut out through zero-width bridges between two existing vertices (keyhole), so that raster fills and even-odd tests agree. Straight edges on the 0.075-deg grid / extent box are cut lines.
